name: design-options
goal: A Plan of a visual unit saves N distinct, separately generated design options (default 3, 1..10) in one immutable version; approval and threads bind one exact option; old single designs still read.

evidence: Default three visual designs; count one to ten; exact option approval and threads; headless plans keep cases.
Opus implemented generation, immutable option storage, count controls and option switching. Product hashes frozen and independently reviewed.
Focused unit/integration checks passed; latest same-guard old UI red and fourteen green browser checks. Fourteen fresh screenshots inspected; compiled/full budgets pending.
